messages:
Evan L: Heads-up - MercuryBank POC. They want quick hosted keys for devs + a Dedicated staging pool for final demo. Need checklist we can paste into CRM.
Sana P: I'll make a compact runbook. Demo Wed 2pm PT, provisioning must be done by Tue EOD.
Evan L: They will use model redwood-open-70b-quant, expected 12rps steady, spikes to 35rps. US data only.
Kai (infra): For that load, recommend 2 GPUs with autoscale min=1,max=3 + KV cache. I'll open infra ticket.
Sana P: Runbook draft:
- Sales intake: get billing contact, dev emails, region, KMS=yes/no (owner: Evan)
- Hosted API key (temp): ops creates scoped key, store in 1Password (owner: Kai)
- Dedicated pool request: infra ticket with model & sizing (owner: Kai)
- Security bundle: SOC2 link, DPA pointer, audit log retention (owner: security-bot)
- Perf snapshot: latency at 512 tokens (owner: Kai)
- Post-demo: revoke keys, scale down pool (owner: Evan)
Kai (infra): ops-bot created INF-4399 for Dedicated provisioning. ETA Tue 08:00 PT.
security-bot: DPA pointer: https://redwood.ai/legal/dpa. SOC2: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2. Default audit logs retention: 30 days.
Evan L: Perfect. I'll collect KMS info from the customer and update the checklist. Thanks :thumbsup:
Kai (infra): Pool live -> INF-4399 status: running. Small perf run: median ~95ms/token @512, p95 ~155ms.
Evan L: Great, sending demo invite now.
Sana P: I'll paste this checklist into the CRM and mark owners.
Evan L: Closing loop - will revoke hosted keys after the demo.
